```text
1	# Editing `index.html` in VS Code, deploying to `gs://emores` via GitHub
2	
3	**End result:** you open the folder in VS Code, edit `index.html`, hit commit + push,
4	and ~30 seconds later the file on your bucket is updated. No console clicking, no drag-and-drop.
5	
6	You only do steps 1–5 once. After that, only step 6 matters.
7	
8	---
9	
10	## Step 1 — Get the current `index.html` onto your computer
11	
12	In the Cloud Storage browser tab you have open:
13	
14	1. Find the `index.html` row.
15	2. Click the **⋮** menu at the far right of that row → **Download** (*Pobierz*).
16	3. Save it somewhere sensible, e.g. `Documents/emores-site/`.
17	
18	Do this *before* anything else — the copy in the bucket is the source of truth right now,
19	and you don't want to overwrite it with an older version later.
20	
21	## Step 2 — Set up the local folder
22	
23	Unzip `emores-site.zip` (the scaffold I sent) into the same place, so you end up with:
24	
25	```
26	emores-site/
27	├── index.html                    <- the file you downloaded in step 1
28	├── .gitignore
29	├── SETUP.md
30	└── .github/
31	    └── workflows/
32	        └── deploy.yml
33	```
34	
35	Then, in a terminal:
36	
37	```bash
38	cd path/to/emores-site
39	git init -b main
40	git add .
41	git commit -m "Initial commit: index.html from gs://emores"
42	```
43	
44	> The `.github` folder starts with a dot, so it's hidden in Finder/Explorer.
45	> It will show up fine in VS Code.
46	
47	## Step 3 — Create the GitHub repo and push
48	
49	1. Go to <https://github.cogit remote add origin https://github.com/m/new>.
50	2. Name it `emores-site`. Set it to **Private** (recommended — it's your live site's source).
51	3. **Do not** tick "Add a README", "Add .gitignore", or "Choose a license". You need an empty repo.
52	4. Click **Create repository**, then run (swap in your username):
53	
54	```bash
55	git remote add origin https://github.com/YOUR-USERNAME/emores-site.git
56	git push -u origin main
57	```
58	
59	If Git asks for a password, it wants a **personal access token**, not your account password —
60	easiest fix is to let VS Code handle it: open the folder in VS Code, click the Source Control
61	icon in the left bar, and use **Publish Branch**, which signs you in through the browser.
62	
63	## Step 4 — Create a service account so GitHub can write to your bucket
64	
65	This is the "key" GitHub uses to upload. It is scoped to *only this bucket*.
66	
67	**4a. Create the account**
68	
69	1. Console → **IAM & Admin** → **Service Accounts** → **Create service account**.
70	2. Name: `github-deploy`. Click **Create and continue**, then **Skip** the optional role step
71	   (you'll grant the role on the bucket instead, which is tighter), then **Done**.
72	3. Copy the email it generated — it looks like
73	   `github-deploy@project-4010577e-246a-46aa-be6.iam.gserviceaccount.com`.
74	
75	**4b. Give it access to just the `emores` bucket**
76	
77	1. Console → **Cloud Storage** → bucket **emores** → **Permissions** (*Uprawnienia*) tab.
78	2. **Grant access** → New principals: paste the service account email.
79	3. Role: **Storage Object User** (`roles/storage.objectUser`). Save.
80	
81	**4c. Create the key**
82	
83	1. Back in **Service Accounts**, click `github-deploy` → **Keys** tab → **Add key** →
84	   **Create new key** → **JSON** → **Create**.
85	2. A `.json` file downloads. Treat it like a password. Do **not** put it in the project folder.
86	
87	## Step 5 — Give the key to GitHub
88	
89	1. Your repo on GitHub → **Settings** → **Secrets and variables** → **Actions**.
90	2. **New repository secret**.
91	3. Name: `GCP_SA_KEY` (exactly this — the workflow looks for that name).
92	4. Secret: open the downloaded `.json` in a text editor, select all, paste the **entire**
93	   contents including the outer `{ }`.
94	5. **Add secret**. Now delete the `.json` file from your Downloads folder — GitHub has it,
95	   and you can always generate a new one.
96	
97	---
98	
99	## Step 6 — Your day-to-day loop
100	
101	```bash
102	code path/to/emores-site      # or just open the folder in VS Code
103	```
104	
105	Edit `index.html`. When you're happy:
106	
107	- **In VS Code:** Source Control panel (`Ctrl+Shift+G`) → type a short message → **Commit** → **Sync/Push**.
108	- **Or in the terminal:**
109	  ```bash
110	  git add index.html
111	  git commit -m "what I changed"
112	  git push
113	  ```
114	
115	Then open the **Actions** tab on GitHub. You'll see a run appear; green tick = deployed.
116	Refresh your site (`Ctrl+Shift+R` for a hard refresh) and the change is live.
117	
118	To check it went through without GitHub:
119	<https://storage.googleapis.com/emores/index.html>
120	
121	---
122	
123	## Things worth knowing
124	
125	**Caching.** The workflow sets `Cache-Control: no-cache` on `index.html`, so browsers re-check
126	it every time and your edits show up immediately. Without this, GCS defaults to caching HTML
127	for an hour and you'd be staring at a stale page wondering why nothing changed.
128	
129	**Public access is preserved.** Your bucket grants public read at the *bucket* level, so a
130	re-uploaded `index.html` stays publicly readable automatically. Nothing to re-do per upload.
131	
132	**The bucket is still the live copy.** If you ever edit `index.html` directly in the console,
133	your local repo goes out of date — the next push will silently overwrite that console edit.
134	Pick one place to edit (the repo) and stick to it.
135	
136	**Undo a bad deploy.** `git revert HEAD && git push` re-uploads the previous version. If you
137	want belt-and-braces, turn on **Object Versioning** on the bucket so old copies are retained.
138	
139	**Adding more files later.** To also deploy `privacy-policy.txt`, `thumbs/`, etc., add them to
140	the repo and change the upload step in `.github/workflows/deploy.yml` to:
141	
142	```yaml
143	      - name: Sync site to gs://emores
144	        run: |
145	          gcloud storage rsync . gs://emores \
146	            --recursive --exclude='^\.git.*' --cache-control="no-cache, max-age=0"
147	```
148	
149	and widen the `paths:` filter at the top (or remove it).
150	
151	**If the workflow fails**, click the failed run in the Actions tab and open the red step:
152	
153	| Error contains | Fix |
154	| --- | --- |
155	| `credentials_json` / `invalid_grant` | The secret isn't valid JSON — re-paste the whole file contents. |
156	| `403` / `does not have storage.objects.create` | Step 4b didn't take. Re-check the role on the bucket. |
157	| `secrets.GCP_SA_KEY` is empty | Secret name typo, or it was added to the wrong repo. |
158
```

   ```
2. **You haven't created it yet** — go to https://github.com/new, create it (private, no README/gitignore/license), then run the same `set-url` command with the real URL, then `git push -u origin main`.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-19 09:56:33Z)**_

If the URL is right, then "Repository not found" almost always means one of these:

1. **The repo doesn't actually exist yet on GitHub** — you created the local repo but haven't hit "Create repository" on github.com yet.
2. **It exists but is private, and your push isn't authenticated** — Git tried the request without valid credentials, and GitHub hides private repos (shows "not found" instead of "403") when you're not authorized.

Let's check your auth situation.

That confirms it: there's no cached GitHub credential in Windows Credential Manager, and my push ran in a non-interactive shell, so Git Credential Manager couldn't pop the browser sign-in window — it just went out unauthenticated. GitHub returns the same generic "Repository not found" for private repos when you're not authenticated, even if `kryptoboi/em` exists and is spelled right.

So this isn't a wrong-URL problem, it's an auth problem, and it needs to happen from an interactive terminal or VS Code (not through me), so the browser sign-in can pop up. Two ways:

**Option A — VS Code (easiest, matches your SETUP.md guide):**
1. Open the `emores-site` folder in VS Code.
2. Source Control icon (`Ctrl+Shift+G`) → **Publish Branch** (or just **Push** since the remote's already set).

**Option B — your own terminal:**
```
git push -u origin main
```
run in a normal terminal window (not through me) — GCM should pop the same browser sign-in.

Once you authenticate once, GCM caches it and future pushes (including from me) will just work. Try one of these and let me know if it still fails.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-19 09:59:37Z)**_

Since GCM needs a real interactive terminal to pop the browser window, this has to happen outside of me — I can't complete a browser login. Here's how:

**Steps:**
1. Open a normal terminal on your machine (Windows Terminal, or the terminal inside VS Code — `` Ctrl+` ``).
2. Navigate to your repo folder:
   ```
   cd path\to\emores-site
   ```
3. Run:
   ```
   git push -u origin main
   ```
4. A browser window should pop up asking you to sign into GitHub. **Sign in as `kryptoboi`** (the account that owns `github.com/kryptoboi/em`) — not any other GitHub account you might be logged into.
5. Approve/authorize, then the terminal push should complete.

**If no browser window pops up** (sometimes GCM stays silent):
- Force it by clearing any stale cached credential first:
  ```
  git credential-manager github logout
  ```
  then run `git push -u origin main` again.

**Or use VS Code instead**, which is more reliable for this:
- Open the folder in VS Code → Source Control panel (`Ctrl+Shift+G`) → **Publish Branch** (or **Sync Changes**) → it triggers the same browser sign-in as `kryptoboi`.

Once signed in, the credential gets cached in Windows Credential Manager, and every future push (including ones I run for you) will just work without asking again.

Let me know once you've signed in and I'll verify the push went through.

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-23 07:15:03Z)**_

A few options, pick what fits your workflow:

**Terminal one-liner** (works right now, no setup):
```
git commit -am "update" && git push
```

**Git alias — true one word** (`git save`):
```
git config --global alias.save '!git commit -am "update" && git push'
```
Then any time: `git save`

**VS Code, actual one click:** In VS Code settings, set `git.postCommitCommand` to `"push"`. Then in Source Control panel you just type a message and hit **Commit** — it auto-pushes too, no separate Sync click needed.

_**User (2026-08-23 08:33:07Z)**_

okay, what about quick edits in code? just use github in browser? or something better, like some lightweight visual editor on android that will sync with github?

---

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-23 08:33:19Z)**_

**`github.dev`** — just navigate to your repo on github.com and either press `.` (period) or swap the URL from `github.com` to `github.dev`. It's the actual VS Code editor running in your browser: file tree, syntax highlighting, and commits go straight through GitHub's API (no local git, no credentials to manage on the phone, syncs automatically). Plain `github.com`'s inline editor works too but is much more basic — fine for a one-line tweak, clunky for anything more.

Tradeoff: it's a browser tool sized for desktop, so on a phone screen it'll feel a bit cramped, and there's no live preview or terminal — but for quick `index.html` edits it beats installing/syncing a separate Android git app.

28	    --text-muted: #7a7870;
29	    --text-dim: #444240;
30	    --radius: 4px;
31	  }
32	
33	  html, body {
34	    background: var(--bg);
35	    color: var(--text);
36	    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace;
37	    font-size: 13px;
38	    min-height: 100vh;
39	  }
40	
41	  /* ── Header ── */
42	  header {
43	    display: flex;
44	    align-items: center;
45	    justify-content: space-between;
46	    padding: 24px 32px 20px;
47	    border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
48	    position: sticky;
49	    top: 0;
50	    background: var(--bg);
51	    z-index: 10;
52	  }
53	  .logo {
54	    font-family: 'Playfair Display', serif;
55	    font-size: 22px;
56	    color: var(--text);
57	  }
58	  .logo span { color: var(--accent); }
59	
60	  .header-right { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; }
61	
62	  #status-dot {
63	    width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%;
64	    background: var(--accent); box-shadow: 0 0 6px var(--accent);
65	    animation: pulse 2s infinite;
66	  }
67	  #status-dot.error { background: #e24b4a; box-shadow: 0 0 6px #e24b4a; animation: none; }
68	  #status-dot.loading { background: var(--text-muted); box-shadow: none; animation: none; }
69	  @keyframes pulse { 0%,100%{opacity:1} 50%{opacity:.3} }
70	
71	  #status-text { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
72	
73	  .btn {
74	    background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border);
75	    color: var(--text-muted); padding: 6px 14px;
76	    border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
77	    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px;
78	    letter-spacing: .05em; transition: all .2s;
79	  }
80	  .btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
81	
82	  /* ── Stats ── */
83	  .stats-bar {
84	    display: flex; gap: 32px;
85	    padding: 14px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
86	  }
87	  .stat { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px; }
88	  .stat-label { color: var(--text-dim); font-size: 10px; letter-spacing: .1em; text-transform: uppercase; }
89	  .stat-value { color: var(--text); font-size: 14px; }
90	  .stat-value.accent { color: var(--accent); }
91	
92	  /* ── Filter bar ── */
93	  .filter-bar {
94	    display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px;
95	    padding: 14px 32px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border);
96	  }
97	  .filter-label { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; letter-spacing: .08em; text-transform: uppercase; }
98	  #search-input {
99	    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
100	    color: var(--text); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius);
101	    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px; width: 220px;
102	    outline: none; transition: border-color .2s;
103	  }
104	  #search-input:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
105	  #search-input::placeholder { color: var(--text-dim); }
106	
107	  .sort-select {
108	    background: var(--surface); border: 1px solid var(--border);
109	    color: var(--text); padding: 6px 12px; border-radius: var(--radius);
110	    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
111	    cursor: pointer; outline: none; transition: border-color .2s;
112	  }
113	  .sort-select:focus { border-color: var(--accent); }
114	
115	  /* ── New banner ── */
116	  #new-banner {
117	    display: none; align-items: center; gap: 10px;
118	    margin: 16px 32px 0; padding: 10px 16px;
119	    background: var(--accent-dim); border: 1px solid rgba(212,168,83,.3);
120	    border-radius: var(--radius); font-size: 12px; color: var(--accent);
121	    cursor: pointer; transition: background .2s;
122	  }
123	  #new-banner:hover { background: rgba(212,168,83,.22); }
124	  #new-banner.visible { display: flex; }
125	  .new-dot { width:6px; height:6px; border-radius:50%; background:var(--accent); flex-shrink:0; }
126	
127	  /* ── Gallery grid ── */
128	  #gallery {
129	    display: grid;
130	    grid-template-columns: repeat(3, 1fr);
131	    gap: 3px;
132	    padding: 18px 32px 40px;
133	  }
134	
135	  /* Tablet portrait */
136	  @media (max-width: 900px) {
137	    #gallery { grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr); }
138	  }
139	
140	  /* Mobile portrait */
141	  @media (max-width: 600px) {
142	    #gallery {
143	      grid-template-columns: repeat(2, 1fr);
144	      padding: 12px 8px 32px;
145	      gap: 2px;
146	    }
147	  }
148	
149	  /* Mobile landscape */
150	  @media (max-width: 900px) and (orientation: landscape) {
151	    #gallery { grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr); }
152	  }
153	
154	  .img-item {
155	    position: relative;
156	    aspect-ratio: 3 / 2;   /* szerokość > wysokość, nie kwadrat */
157	    overflow: hidden;
158	    background: var(--surface);
159	    cursor: pointer;
160	    transition: transform .18s;
161	  }
162	  .img-item.portrait {
163	    aspect-ratio: 2 / 3;   /* pionowy format */
164	    width: 44%;
165	    margin-left: auto;
166	    margin-right: auto;
167	  }
168	  .img-item:hover { transform: scale(1.02); z-index: 2; }
169	
170	  .img-item.is-new::after {
171	    content: 'NEW'; position: absolute; top: 8px; right: 8px;
172	    background: var(--accent); color: #0c0c0e;
173	    font-size: 9px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .1em;
174	    padding: 2px 6px; border-radius: 2px;
175	  }
176	
177	  .img-item img {
178	    width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; display: block;
179	    transition: opacity .3s; opacity: 0;
180	  }
181	  .img-item img.loaded { opacity: 1; }
182	
183	  .img-overlay {
184	    position: absolute; bottom:0; left:0; right:0;
185	    padding: 28px 10px 8px;
186	    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.75));
187	    opacity: 0; transition: opacity .2s;
188	    font-size: 10px; color: #eee; word-break: break-all; line-height: 1.4;
189	  }
190	  .img-item:hover .img-overlay { opacity: 1; }
191	
192	  /* ── Load more ── */
193	  #load-more-wrap {
194	    display: flex; justify-content: center;
195	    padding: 0 32px 48px;
196	  }
197	  #load-more-btn {
198	    background: none; border: 1px solid var(--border);
199	    color: var(--text-muted); padding: 10px 32px;
200	    border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
201	    font-family: 'DM Mono', monospace; font-size: 12px;
202	    letter-spacing: .06em; transition: all .2s;
203	  }
204	  #load-more-btn:hover { border-color: var(--accent); color: var(--accent); }
205	  #load-more-btn:disabled { opacity: .3; cursor: default; }
206	  #load-more-btn.hidden { display: none; }
207	
208	  /* ── Skeleton ── */
209	  .skeleton {
210	    aspect-ratio: 3/2; background: var(--surface);
211	    position: relative; overflow: hidden;
212	  }
213	  .skeleton::after {
214	    content:''; position:absolute; inset:0;
215	    background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 50%,transparent 100%);
216	    animation: shimmer 1.4s infinite;
217	  }
218	  @keyframes shimmer { from{transform:translateX(-100%)} to{transform:translateX(100%)} }
219	
220	  /* ── CORS hint ── */
221	  #cors-hint {
222	    display:none; margin:0 32px; padding:14px 18px;
223	    background:rgba(226,75,74,.08); border:1px solid rgba(226,75,74,.25);
224	    border-radius:var(--radius); color:#f09595; font-size:12px; line-height:1.6;
225	  }
226	  #cors-hint.visible { display:block; }
227	  #cors-hint code { background:rgba(255,255,255,.06); padding:1px 5px; border-radius:2px; font-size:11px; }
228	
229	  /* ── Message ── */
230	  #message {
231	    display:none; flex-direction:column; align-items:center;
232	    gap:12px; padding:80px 32px; color:var(--text-muted);
233	    font-size:13px; text-align:center;
234	  }
235	  #message.visible { display:flex; }
236	
237	  /* ════════════════════════════════════════
238	     LIGHTBOX
239	  ════════════════════════════════════════ */
240	  #lightbox {
241	    display: none;
242	    position: fixed; inset: 0;
243	    background: rgba(0,0,0,0.94);
244	    z-index: 200;
245	    flex-direction: column;
246	    align-items: center;
247	    justify-content: center;
248	    overflow: hidden;
249	    touch-action: none;
250	  }
251	  #lightbox.open { display: flex; }
252	
253	  #lb-toolbar {
254	    position: fixed; top: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
255	    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between;
256	    padding: 12px 20px;
257	    background: linear-gradient(rgba(0,0,0,.7), transparent);
258	    z-index: 210;
259	    gap: 12px;
260	  }
261	  #lb-name {
262	    color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px;
263	    letter-spacing: .04em; flex: 1;
264	    overflow: hidden; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap;
265	  }
266	  #lb-zoom-level {
267	    color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 12px;
268	    min-width: 48px; text-align: center;
269	  }
270	  .lb-btn {
271	    background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);
272	    color: var(--text); width: 36px; height: 36px;
273	    border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
274	    font-size: 18px; line-height: 1;
275	    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
276	    transition: background .15s; user-select: none;
277	    flex-shrink: 0;
278	  }
279	  .lb-btn:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.12); }
280	
281	  #lb-canvas {
282	    position: fixed; inset: 0;
283	    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
284	    overflow: hidden;
285	    cursor: grab;
286	  }
287	  #lb-canvas.grabbing { cursor: grabbing; }
288	
289	  #lb-spinner {
290	    position: absolute;
291	    width: 40px; height: 40px;
292	    border: 2px solid var(--border);
293	    border-top-color: var(--accent);
294	    border-radius: 50%;
295	    animation: spin .8s linear infinite;
296	    pointer-events: none;
297	  }
298	  @keyframes spin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
299	  #lb-spinner.hidden { display: none; }
300	
301	  #lb-img {
302	    position: absolute;
303	    transform-origin: 0 0;
304	    will-change: transform;
305	    max-width: none; max-height: none;
306	    user-select: none; -webkit-user-drag: none;
307	    transition: opacity .25s;
308	    opacity: 0;
309	    display: block;
310	  }
311	  #lb-img.loaded { opacity: 1; }
312	
313	  .lb-arrow {
314	    position: fixed; top: 50%; transform: translateY(-50%);
315	    background: rgba(255,255,255,.06); border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1);
316	    color: var(--text); width: 44px; height: 44px;
317	    border-radius: var(--radius); cursor: pointer;
318	    font-size: 20px; line-height: 1;
319	    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
320	    transition: background .15s, opacity .2s;
321	    z-index: 210; user-select: none;
322	  }
323	  .lb-arrow:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
324	  .lb-arrow.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
325	  #lb-prev { left: 12px; }
326	  #lb-next { right: 12px; }
327	
328	  #lb-footer {
329	    position: fixed; bottom: 0; left: 0; right: 0;
330	    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
331	    padding: 12px 20px;
332	    background: linear-gradient(transparent, rgba(0,0,0,.7));
333	    z-index: 210;
334	  }
335	  #lb-counter { color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; }
336	
337	  /* ── Scrollbar ── */
338	  ::-webkit-scrollbar { width: 6px; }
339	  ::-webkit-scrollbar-track { background: var(--bg); }
340	  ::-webkit-scrollbar-thumb { background: var(--text-dim); border-radius: 3px; }
341	
342	  @media (max-width: 600px) {
343	    header { padding: 16px 16px 14px; }
344	    .stats-bar { padding: 10px 16px; gap: 20px; overflow-x: auto; flex-wrap: nowrap; }
345	    .filter-bar { padding: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
346	    .lb-arrow { display: none; }
347	    #load-more-wrap { padding: 0 16px 32px; }
348	  }
349	</style>
350	</head>
351	<body>
352	
353	<header>
354	  <div class="logo">emoresz<span>.</span></div>
355	  <div class="header-right">
356	    <div id="status-dot" class="loading"></div>
357	    <span id="status-text">łączenie…</span>
358	    <button class="btn" id="refresh-btn">↺ odśwież</button>
359	  </div>
360	</header>
361	
362	<div class="stats-bar">
363	  <div class="stat">
364	    <span class="stat-label">Wszystkie obrazy</span>
365	    <span class="stat-value" id="total-count">—</span>
366	  </div>
367	  <div class="stat">
368	    <span class="stat-label">Nowe (24h)</span>
369	    <span class="stat-value accent" id="new-count">—</span>
370	  </div>
371	  <div class="stat">
372	    <span class="stat-label">Ostatnie odświeżenie</span>
373	    <span class="stat-value" id="last-refresh">—</span>
374	  </div>
375	  <div class="stat">
376	    <span class="stat-label">Następne za</span>
377	    <span class="stat-value" id="next-refresh">—</span>
378	  </div>
379	</div>
380	
381	<div class="filter-bar">
382	  <span class="filter-label">Filtr</span>
383	  <input type="text" id="search-input" placeholder="szukaj po nazwie…" />
384	  <select class="sort-select" id="sort-select">
385	    <option value="newest">Najnowsze</option>
386	    <option value="oldest">Najstarsze</option>
387	    <option value="name">Nazwa A–Z</option>
388	    <option value="size">Rozmiar</option>
389	  </select>
390	</div>
391	
392	<div id="cors-hint"></div>
393	<div id="new-banner"><span class="new-dot"></span><span id="new-banner-text"></span></div>
394	
395	<div id="gallery"></div>
396	<div id="load-more-wrap">
397	  <button id="load-more-btn" class="hidden">Wczytaj więcej</button>
398	</div>
399	<div id="message"><span id="message-text">Ładowanie…</span></div>
400	
401	<!-- ── Lightbox ── -->
402	<div id="lightbox" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Podgląd obrazu">
403	  <div id="lb-toolbar">
404	    <span id="lb-name"></span>
405	    <span id="lb-zoom-level">100%</span>
406	    <button class="lb-btn" id="lb-zoom-out" title="Pomniejsz (−)">−</button>
407	    <button class="lb-btn" id="lb-zoom-in" title="Powiększ (+)">+</button>
408	    <button class="lb-btn" id="lb-zoom-fit" title="Dopasuj (0)">⊡</button>
409	    <button class="lb-btn" id="lb-download" title="Pobierz">↓</button>
410	    <button class="lb-btn" id="lb-close" title="Zamknij (Esc)">✕</button>
411	  </div>
412	
413	  <div id="lb-canvas">
414	    <div id="lb-spinner"></div>
415	    <img id="lb-img" src="" alt="" draggable="false" />
416	  </div>
417	
418	  <button class="lb-arrow" id="lb-prev">‹</button>
419	  <button class="lb-arrow" id="lb-next">›</button>
420	
421	  <div id="lb-footer">
422	    <span id="lb-counter"></span>
423	  </div>
424	</div>
425	
426	<script>
427	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
428	//  CONFIG
429	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
430	const BUCKET_URL   = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/emores/';
431	const ORIG_PREFIX  = 'emores2/';            // oryginały w root
432	const THUMB_PREFIX = 'thumbs/';     // miniatury w tym folderze
433	const PAGE_SIZE    = 10;             // ile zdjęć wczytać na raz
434	const REFRESH_SEC  = 5;
435	const ZOOM_STEP    = 0.25;
436	const ZOOM_MIN     = 0.1;
437	const ZOOM_MAX     = 8;
438	const IMAGE_EXT    = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|bmp|tiff?)$/i;
439	
440	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
441	//  STATE
442	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
443	let allImages     = [];   // wszystkie pobrane [{key, size, lastMod, url, thumbUrl}]
444	let visibleImages = [];   // po filtrach/sortowaniu
445	let renderedCount = 0;    // ile kafelek już wyrenderowano
446	let knownKeys     = new Set();
447	let pendingNew    = [];
448	let countdown     = REFRESH_SEC;
449	let countdownTimer = null;
450	let initialized   = false;
451	
452	// Lightbox state
453	let lbIndex  = 0;
454	let lbScale  = 1;
455	let lbTransX = 0;
456	let lbTransY = 0;
457	let lbNaturalW = 0;
458	let lbNaturalH = 0;
459	
460	// Drag
461	let isDragging = false;
462	let dragStartX = 0, dragStartY = 0;
463	let dragOriginX = 0, dragOriginY = 0;
464	
465	// Pinch
466	let lastPinchDist = null;
467	let lastPinchScale = 1;
468	
469	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
470	//  DOM REFS
471	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
472	const gallery       = document.getElementById('gallery');
473	const statusDot     = document.getElementById('status-dot');
474	const statusText    = document.getElementById('status-text');
475	const totalCount    = document.getElementById('total-count');
476	const newCount      = document.getElementById('new-count');
477	const lastRefresh   = document.getElementById('last-refresh');
478	const nextRefresh   = document.getElementById('next-refresh');
479	const searchInput   = document.getElementById('search-input');
480	const sortSelect    = document.getElementById('sort-select');
481	const newBanner     = document.getElementById('new-banner');
482	const newBannerTxt  = document.getElementById('new-banner-text');
483	const message       = document.getElementById('message');
484	const messageTxt    = document.getElementById('message-text');
485	const corsHint      = document.getElementById('cors-hint');
486	const loadMoreBtn   = document.getElementById('load-more-btn');
487	const loadMoreWrap  = document.getElementById('load-more-wrap');
488	
489	const lightbox  = document.getElementById('lightbox');
490	const lbCanvas  = document.getElementById('lb-canvas');
491	const lbImg     = document.getElementById('lb-img');
492	const lbSpinner = document.getElementById('lb-spinner');
493	const lbName    = document.getElementById('lb-name');
494	const lbZoom    = document.getElementById('lb-zoom-level');
495	const lbCounter = document.getElementById('lb-counter');
496	const lbPrev    = document.getElementById('lb-prev');
497	const lbNext    = document.getElementById('lb-next');
498	
499	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
500	//  UTILS
501	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
502	const setStatus = (cls, txt) => { statusDot.className = cls; statusText.textContent = txt; };
503	const fmtSize   = b => b < 1024 ? b+'B' : b < 1048576 ? (b/1024).toFixed(1)+'KB' : (b/1048576).toFixed(1)+'MB';
504	const fmtTime   = iso => { const d=new Date(iso); return d.toLocaleDateString('pl-PL')+' '+d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); };
505	const isNew24h  = iso => Date.now()-new Date(iso).getTime() < 86400000;
506	const clamp     = (v,mn,mx) => Math.min(mx,Math.max(mn,v));
507	
508	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
509	//  FETCH & PARSE
510	//  Oryginały: gs://emores/emores2/foto.jpg
511	//  Thumbnaily: gs://emores/thumbs/foto_64x64_thumbnail.jpg
512	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
513	async function fetchListing() {
514	  setStatus('loading', 'pobieranie…');
515	  try {
516	    const res = await fetch(BUCKET_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
517	    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+res.status);
518	    const xml = await res.text();
519	    return parseXML(xml);
520	  } catch(err) {
521	    if (/fetch|Network|CORS/i.test(err.message)) showCorsHint();
522	    throw err;
523	  }
524	}
525	
526	function parseXML(xml) {
527	  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml');
528	  const thumbKeys = new Set();
529	  const items = [];
530	
531	  // Zbierz wszystkie klucze miniatur
532	  doc.querySelectorAll('Contents').forEach(n => {
533	    const key = n.querySelector('Key')?.textContent || '';
534	    if (key.startsWith(THUMB_PREFIX)) thumbKeys.add(key);
535	  });
536	
537	  // Zbierz oryginały z folderu emores2/
538	  doc.querySelectorAll('Contents').forEach(n => {
539	    const key = n.querySelector('Key')?.textContent || '';
540	
541	    // Pokaż tylko obrazki z folderu emores2/
542	    const isImage = key.startsWith(ORIG_PREFIX) && IMAGE_EXT.test(key);
543	
544	    if (!isImage) return;
545	
546	    const size    = parseInt(n.querySelector('Size')?.textContent||'0');
547	    const lastMod = n.querySelector('LastModified')?.textContent||'';
548	    const baseName = key.includes('/') ? key.split('/').pop() : key;
549	    const nameParts = baseName.split('.');
550	    const ext = nameParts.pop().toLowerCase();
551	    const nameNoExt = nameParts.join('.');
552	    const thumbKey = THUMB_PREFIX + nameNoExt + '_64x64_thumbnail.' + ext;
553	
554	    items.push({
555	      key,
556	      size,
557	      lastMod,
558	      url:      BUCKET_URL + key.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'),
559	      thumbUrl: BUCKET_URL + thumbKey.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'),
560	      hasThumb: thumbKeys.has(thumbKey)
561	    });
562	  });
563	
564	  return items;
565	}
566	
567	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
568	//  RENDER GALLERY z lazy loading (PAGE_SIZE na raz)
569	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
570	function applyFiltersAndSort(imgs) {
571	  const q  = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
572	  const by = sortSelect.value;
573	  let arr  = q ? imgs.filter(i => i.key.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : [...imgs];
574	  if (by==='newest') arr.sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.lastMod)-new Date(a.lastMod));
575	  else if (by==='oldest') arr.sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.lastMod)-new Date(b.lastMod));
576	  else if (by==='name')   arr.sort((a,b)=>a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
577	  else if (by==='size')   arr.sort((a,b)=>b.size-a.size);
578	  return arr;
579	}
580	
581	function renderGallery(imgs, highlight=new Set()) {
582	  visibleImages = applyFiltersAndSort(imgs);
583	  renderedCount = 0;
584	  gallery.innerHTML = '';
585	
586	  if (!visibleImages.length) {
587	    messageTxt.textContent = searchInput.value ? 'Brak wyników.' : 'Brak obrazów w buckecie.';
588	    message.classList.add('visible');
589	    loadMoreBtn.classList.add('hidden');
590	    return;
591	  }
592	  message.classList.remove('visible');
593	  renderNextPage(highlight);
594	}
595	
596	let loadMoreSentinel = null;
597	
598	function renderNextPage(highlight=new Set()) {
599	  const batch = visibleImages.slice(renderedCount, renderedCount + PAGE_SIZE);
600	
601	  // Usuń poprzedni sentinel
602	  if (loadMoreSentinel) loadMoreSentinel.remove();
603	
604	  batch.forEach((img, i) => {
605	    const idx = renderedCount + i;
606	    const isN = highlight.has(img.key);
607	    const src = img.hasThumb ? img.thumbUrl : img.url;
608	
609	    const item = document.createElement('div');
610	    item.className = 'img-item' + (isN ? ' is-new' : '');
611	    item.dataset.idx = idx;
612	    item.innerHTML = `
613	      <img src="${src}" alt="${img.key}" loading="lazy" />
614	      <div class="img-overlay">${img.key.split('/').pop()}<br>${fmtSize(img.size)} · ${fmtTime(img.lastMod)}</div>`;
615	
616	    const imgEl = item.querySelector('img');
617	    imgEl.addEventListener('load', () => {
618	      imgEl.classList.add('loaded');
619	      if (imgEl.naturalHeight > imgEl.naturalWidth) {
620	        item.classList.add('portrait');
621	      }
622	    });
623	    imgEl.addEventListener('error', () => {
624	      if (img.url && imgEl.src !== img.url) imgEl.src = img.url;
625	    });
626	    item.addEventListener('click', () => openLightbox(idx));
627	    gallery.appendChild(item);
628	  });
629	
630	  renderedCount += batch.length;
631	
632	  // Jeśli są jeszcze obrazy do wczytania, stwórz sentinel do infinite scroll
633	  if (renderedCount < visibleImages.length) {
634	    loadMoreSentinel = document.createElement('div');
635	    loadMoreSentinel.style.gridColumn = '1 / -1';
636	    loadMoreSentinel.style.height = '1px';
637	    gallery.appendChild(loadMoreSentinel);
638	    infiniteScrollObserver.observe(loadMoreSentinel);
639	  } else {
640	    loadMoreSentinel = null;
641	  }
642	}
643	
644	// IntersectionObserver do infinite scroll
645	const infiniteScrollObserver = new IntersectionObserver(entries => {
646	  entries.forEach(entry => {
647	    if (entry.isIntersecting) {
648	      renderNextPage();
649	    }
650	  });
651	}, { rootMargin: '100px' });
652	
653	// Ukryj przycisk "wczytaj więcej"
654	loadMoreWrap.style.display = 'none';
655	
656	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
657	//  LOAD DATA
658	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
659	async function load(isInitial=false) {
660	  try {
661	    const imgs = await fetchListing();
662	    const newKeys = new Set();
663	    if (!isInitial && knownKeys.size>0)
664	      imgs.forEach(i => { if (!knownKeys.has(i.key)) newKeys.add(i.key); });
665	
666	    knownKeys = new Set(imgs.map(i=>i.key));
667	    allImages = imgs;
668	
669	    totalCount.textContent  = imgs.length;
670	    newCount.textContent    = imgs.filter(i=>isNew24h(i.lastMod)).length;
671	    lastRefresh.textContent = new Date().toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit',second:'2-digit'});
672	
673	    renderGallery(imgs, newKeys);
674	    setStatus('', 'aktywny');
675	    corsHint.classList.remove('visible');
676	
677	    if (newKeys.size>0) {
678	      pendingNew = [...newKeys];
679	      newBannerTxt.textContent = `${newKeys.size} nowych obrazów — kliknij, aby zobaczyć`;
680	      newBanner.classList.add('visible');
681	    }
682	    initialized = true;
683	  } catch(err) {
684	    setStatus('error','błąd połączenia');
685	    if (!initialized) {
686	      messageTxt.textContent = 'Nie można pobrać listy. Sprawdź URL bucketu i uprawnienia.';
687	      message.classList.add('visible');
688	    }
689	    console.error('[emores]', err);
690	  }
691	}
692	
693	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
694	//  LIGHTBOX — OPEN / CLOSE / NAV
695	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
696	function openLightbox(idx) {
697	  lbIndex = idx;
698	  lightbox.classList.add('open');
699	  document.body.style.overflow = 'hidden';
700	  loadLightboxImage();
701	}
702	
703	function closeLightbox() {
704	  lightbox.classList.remove('open');
705	  document.body.style.overflow = '';
706	  lbImg.src = '';
707	  lbImg.classList.remove('loaded');
708	}
709	
710	function loadLightboxImage() {
711	  const img = visibleImages[lbIndex];
712	  if (!img) return;
713	
714	  lbName.textContent    = img.key.split('/').pop();
715	  lbCounter.textContent = `${lbIndex+1} / ${visibleImages.length}`;
716	  lbPrev.classList.toggle('hidden', lbIndex===0);
717	  lbNext.classList.toggle('hidden', lbIndex===visibleImages.length-1);
718	
719	  lbImg.classList.remove('loaded');
720	  lbSpinner.classList.remove('hidden');
721	
722	  const fullImg = new Image();
723	  fullImg.onload = () => {
724	    lbNaturalW = fullImg.naturalWidth;
725	    lbNaturalH = fullImg.naturalHeight;
726	    lbImg.src = img.url;
727	    lbImg.onload = () => {
728	      lbSpinner.classList.add('hidden');
729	      lbImg.classList.add('loaded');
730	      resetZoom();
731	    };
732	  };
733	  fullImg.onerror = () => { lbSpinner.classList.add('hidden'); };
734	  fullImg.src = img.url;
735	}
736	
737	function navigate(dir) {
738	  const next = lbIndex + dir;
739	  if (next < 0 || next >= visibleImages.length) return;
740	  lbIndex = next;
741	  loadLightboxImage();
742	}
743	
744	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
745	//  LIGHTBOX — ZOOM & PAN
746	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
747	function applyTransform() {
748	  const vw = lbCanvas.clientWidth;
749	  const vh = lbCanvas.clientHeight;
750	  const iw = lbImg.clientWidth  || lbNaturalW;
751	  const ih = lbImg.clientHeight || lbNaturalH;
752	
753	  const scaledW = iw * lbScale;
754	  const scaledH = ih * lbScale;
755	  const maxX = Math.max(0, (scaledW - vw) / 2);
756	  const maxY = Math.max(0, (scaledH - vh) / 2);
757	
758	  lbTransX = clamp(lbTransX, -maxX, maxX);
759	  lbTransY = clamp(lbTransY, -maxY, maxY);
760	
761	  const cx = (vw - iw) / 2;
762	  const cy = (vh - ih) / 2;
763	
764	  lbImg.style.transform = `translate(${cx + lbTransX}px, ${cy + lbTransY}px) scale(${lbScale})`;
765	  lbZoom.textContent = Math.round(lbScale * 100) + '%';
766	}
767	
768	function zoomBy(delta, pivotX, pivotY) {
769	  const newScale = clamp(lbScale * (1 + delta), ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX);
770	  if (newScale === lbScale) return;
771	
772	  const vw = lbCanvas.clientWidth;
773	  const vh = lbCanvas.clientHeight;
774	  const px = (pivotX ?? vw/2) - vw/2;
775	  const py = (pivotY ?? vh/2) - vh/2;
776	
777	  const ratio = newScale / lbScale;
778	  lbTransX = px + (lbTransX - px) * ratio;
779	  lbTransY = py + (lbTransY - py) * ratio;
780	  lbScale = newScale;
781	  applyTransform();
782	}
783	
784	function resetZoom() {
785	  lbScale  = 1;
786	  lbTransX = 0;
787	  lbTransY = 0;
788	  applyTransform();
789	}
790	
791	function fitToScreen() {
792	  if (!lbNaturalW || !lbNaturalH) { resetZoom(); return; }
793	  const vw = lbCanvas.clientWidth;
794	  const vh = lbCanvas.clientHeight;
795	  const fit = Math.min(vw / lbNaturalW, vh / lbNaturalH, 1);
796	  lbScale  = fit;
797	  lbTransX = 0;
798	  lbTransY = 0;
799	  applyTransform();
800	}
801	
802	// ── Mouse drag ──
803	lbCanvas.addEventListener('mousedown', e => {
804	  if (e.button !== 0) return;
805	  isDragging = true;
806	  dragStartX = e.clientX;
807	  dragStartY = e.clientY;
808	  dragOriginX = lbTransX;
809	  dragOriginY = lbTransY;
810	  lbCanvas.classList.add('grabbing');
811	  e.preventDefault();
812	});
813	
814	window.addEventListener('mousemove', e => {
815	  if (!isDragging) return;
816	  lbTransX = dragOriginX + (e.clientX - dragStartX);
817	  lbTransY = dragOriginY + (e.clientY - dragStartY);
818	  applyTransform();
819	});
820	
821	window.addEventListener('mouseup', () => {
822	  isDragging = false;
823	  lbCanvas.classList.remove('grabbing');
824	});
825	
826	lbCanvas.addEventListener('wheel', e => {
827	  e.preventDefault();
828	  const rect = lbCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
829	  const px = e.clientX - rect.left;
830	  const py = e.clientY - rect.top;
831	  const delta = e.deltaY < 0 ? 0.15 : -0.15;
832	  zoomBy(delta, px, py);
833	}, { passive: false });
834	
835	lbCanvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => {
836	  if (e.touches.length === 1) {
837	    isDragging = true;
838	    dragStartX = e.touches[0].clientX;
839	    dragStartY = e.touches[0].clientY;
840	    dragOriginX = lbTransX;
841	    dragOriginY = lbTransY;
842	    lastPinchDist = null;
843	  } else if (e.touches.length === 2) {
844	    isDragging = false;
845	    const dx = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
846	    const dy = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
847	    lastPinchDist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
848	    lastPinchScale = lbScale;
849	  }
850	  e.preventDefault();
851	}, { passive: false });
852	
853	lbCanvas.addEventListener('touchmove', e => {
854	  if (e.touches.length === 1 && isDragging) {
855	    lbTransX = dragOriginX + (e.touches[0].clientX - dragStartX);
856	    lbTransY = dragOriginY + (e.touches[0].clientY - dragStartY);
857	    applyTransform();
858	  } else if (e.touches.length === 2 && lastPinchDist !== null) {
859	    const dx   = e.touches[0].clientX - e.touches[1].clientX;
860	    const dy   = e.touches[0].clientY - e.touches[1].clientY;
861	    const dist = Math.hypot(dx, dy);
862	    const cx   = (e.touches[0].clientX + e.touches[1].clientX) / 2;
863	    const cy   = (e.touches[0].clientY + e.touches[1].clientY) / 2;
864	    const rect = lbCanvas.getBoundingClientRect();
865	    const newScale = clamp(lastPinchScale * (dist / lastPinchDist), ZOOM_MIN, ZOOM_MAX);
866	    const ratio = newScale / lbScale;
867	    const px = cx - rect.left - lbCanvas.clientWidth/2;
868	    const py = cy - rect.top  - lbCanvas.clientHeight/2;
869	    lbTransX = px + (lbTransX - px) * ratio;
870	    lbTransY = py + (lbTransY - py) * ratio;
871	    lbScale  = newScale;
872	    applyTransform();
873	  }
874	  e.preventDefault();
875	}, { passive: false });
876	
877	lbCanvas.addEventListener('touchend', e => {
878	  if (e.touches.length < 2) lastPinchDist = null;
879	  if (e.touches.length === 0) isDragging = false;
880	});
881	
882	// ── Keyboard ──
883	document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
884	  if (!lightbox.classList.contains('open')) return;
885	  if (e.key==='Escape')           closeLightbox();
886	  else if (e.key==='ArrowLeft')   navigate(-1);
887	  else if (e.key==='ArrowRight')  navigate(1);
888	  else if (e.key==='+' || e.key==='=') zoomBy(ZOOM_STEP);
889	  else if (e.key==='-')           zoomBy(-ZOOM_STEP);
890	  else if (e.key==='0')           resetZoom();
891	  else if (e.key==='f')           fitToScreen();
892	});
893	
894	lbCanvas.addEventListener('dblclick', resetZoom);
895	
896	document.getElementById('lb-zoom-in').addEventListener('click',  () => zoomBy(ZOOM_STEP));
897	document.getElementById('lb-zoom-out').addEventListener('click', () => zoomBy(-ZOOM_STEP));
898	document.getElementById('lb-zoom-fit').addEventListener('click', fitToScreen);
899	document.getElementById('lb-close').addEventListener('click', closeLightbox);
900	lbPrev.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(-1));
901	lbNext.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(1));
902	
903	document.getElementById('lb-download').addEventListener('click', () => {
904	  const img = visibleImages[lbIndex];
905	  if (!img) return;
906	  const a = document.createElement('a');
907	  a.href = img.url;
908	  a.download = img.key.split('/').pop();
909	  a.click();
910	});
911	
912	lightbox.addEventListener('click', e => {
913	  if (e.target === lightbox) closeLightbox();
914	});
915	
916	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
917	//  MISC EVENTS
918	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
919	document.getElementById('refresh-btn').addEventListener('click', () => {
920	  clearInterval(countdownTimer);
921	  load().then(startCountdown);
922	});
923	
924	newBanner.addEventListener('click', () => {
925	  window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});
926	  newBanner.classList.remove('visible');
927	  renderGallery(allImages, new Set(pendingNew));
928	});
929	
930	searchInput.addEventListener('input',  () => renderGallery(allImages));
931	sortSelect.addEventListener('change',  () => renderGallery(allImages));
932	
933	function showCorsHint() {
934	  corsHint.innerHTML = `
935	    <strong>Błąd CORS lub dostępu</strong> — bucket musi być publiczny i mieć politykę CORS:<br>
936	    <code>[{"origin":["*"],"method":["GET","HEAD"],"maxAgeSeconds":3600}]</code><br>
937	    Zastosuj: <code>gcloud storage buckets update gs://emores --cors-file=cors.json</code>`;
938	  corsHint.classList.add('visible');
939	}
940	
941	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
942	//  COUNTDOWN & INIT
943	// ══════════════════════════════════════════════════════════════
944	function startCountdown() {
945	  countdown = REFRESH_SEC;
946	  clearInterval(countdownTimer);
947	  countdownTimer = setInterval(() => {
948	    countdown--;
949	    nextRefresh.textContent = `za ${countdown}s`;
950	    if (countdown <= 0) { clearInterval(countdownTimer); load().then(startCountdown); }
951	  }, 1000);
952	}
953	
954	// Szkielety podczas ładowania
955	gallery.innerHTML = Array.from({length:6},()=>'<div class="skeleton"></div>').join('');
956	
957	load(true).then(startCountdown);
958	</script>
959	</body>
960	</html>
961

_**Agent (claude-sonnet-5 2026-08-23 11:50:49Z)**_

<tool-use data-tool-type="generic" data-tool-name="AskUserQuestion"><details>
<summary>Tool use: **AskUserQuestion**</summary>
**How should the sort/reorder editor authenticate to save changes to the bucket?**

Options:
- **Secret-URL admin page (Recommended)** - A hidden admin.html with a secret token baked into the URL, backed by a small new Cloud Run endpoint that writes order.json when it sees the right token. Works from any browser, including your Android phone. Reasonably secure since the URL/token isn't public, but not bulletproof if the link leaks.
- **Google Sign-In restricted to your account** - Proper OAuth login, only your Google account can save. More secure, but needs more setup (OAuth client + server-side token verification) before it's usable.
- **Local-only tool (desktop only)** - Runs on your computer using your existing gcloud login, no new cloud endpoint needed. Simplest to build and most secure, but can't be used from your phone.


**Answer:** Secret-URL admin page (Recommended)
</details></tool-use>

<summary>Tool use: **Write**</summary>

```javascript
const http = require('http');
const { Storage } = require('@google-cloud/storage');

const storage = new Storage();
const BUCKET = 'emores';
const ADMIN_TOKEN = process.env.ADMIN_TOKEN;

function send(res, status, body) {
  res.writeHead(status, { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' });
  res.end(JSON.stringify(body));
}

const server = http.createServer((req, res) => {
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Origin', '*');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Methods', 'POST, OPTIONS');
  res.setHeader('Access-Control-Allow-Headers', 'Content-Type, Authorization');

  if (req.method === 'OPTIONS') { res.writeHead(204); res.end(); return; }
  if (req.method !== 'POST') { send(res, 405, { error: 'method not allowed' }); return; }

  let body = '';
  let tooBig = false;
  req.on('data', chunk => {
    body += chunk;
    if (body.length > 2_000_000) { tooBig = true; req.destroy(); }
  });

  req.on('end', async () => {
    if (tooBig) return;
    try {
      const authHeader = req.headers['authorization'] || '';
      const token = authHeader.replace(/^Bearer\s+/i, '');
      if (!ADMIN_TOKEN || token !== ADMIN_TOKEN) {
        send(res, 401, { error: 'unauthorized' });
        return;
      }

      const data = JSON.parse(body);
      if (!Array.isArray(data.order) || !data.order.every(k => typeof k === 'string')) {
        throw new Error('order must be an array of strings');
      }

      const payload = JSON.stringify({
        order: data.order,
        mode: typeof data.mode === 'string' ? data.mode : 'manual',
        updatedAt: new Date().toISOString(),
      });

      await storage.bucket(BUCKET).file('order.json').save(payload, {
        contentType: 'application/json; charset=utf-8',
        metadata: { cacheControl: 'no-cache, max-age=0' },
      });

      send(res, 200, { ok: true });
    } catch (err) {
      send(res, 400, { error: err.message });
    }
  });
});

const port = process.env.PORT || 8080;
server.listen(port, () => console.log('save-order listening on', port));

```

    font-size: 20px; line-height: 1;
    display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center;
    z-index: 210;
  }
  .pl-arrow:hover { background: rgba(255,255,255,.14); }
  .pl-arrow.hidden { opacity: 0; pointer-events: none; }
  #pl-prev { left: 12px; }
  #pl-next { right: 12px; }
  #pl-counter {
    position: fixed; bottom: 16px; left: 0; right: 0; text-align: center;
    color: var(--text-muted); font-size: 11px; z-index: 210;
  }

  @media (max-width: 600px) {
    header { padding: 16px 16px 14px; }
    .filter-bar { padding: 10px 16px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
    .pl-arrow { display: none; }
  }
</style>
</head>
<body>

<header>
  <div class="logo">emoresz<span>.</span></div>
  <nav class="top-nav"><a href="index.html">Zdjęcia</a></nav>
  <div class="header-right">
    <button class="btn" id="refresh-btn">↺ odśwież</button>
  </div>
</header>

<div class="filter-bar">
  <span class="filter-label">Filtr</span>
  <input type="text" id="search-input" placeholder="szukaj po nazwie…" />
  <select class="sort-select" id="sort-select">
    <option value="newest">Najnowsze</option>
    <option value="oldest">Najstarsze</option>
    <option value="name">Nazwa A–Z</option>
    <option value="size">Rozmiar</option>
    <option value="custom">Kolejność własna</option>
  </select>
</div>

<div id="gallery"></div>
<div id="message"><span id="message-text">Ładowanie…</span></div>

<div id="player" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-label="Odtwarzacz wideo">
  <div id="pl-toolbar">
    <span id="pl-name"></span>
    <button class="pl-btn" id="pl-close" title="Zamknij (Esc)">✕</button>
  </div>
  <video id="pl-video" controls playsinline></video>
  <button class="pl-arrow" id="pl-prev">‹</button>
  <button class="pl-arrow" id="pl-next">›</button>
  <div id="pl-counter"></div>
</div>

<script>
const BUCKET_URL  = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/emores/';
const ORIG_PREFIX = 'emores2/';
const ORDER_URL   = BUCKET_URL + 'order.json?ts=' + Date.now();
const VIDEO_EXT   = /\.(mp4|mov|webm|mkv|avi|m4v)$/i;
const THUMB_CACHE_PREFIX = 'emores_vthumb_';
const THUMB_W = 320;

let allVideos     = [];
let visibleVideos = [];
let customOrder   = null;
let plIndex       = 0;

const gallery      = document.getElementById('gallery');
const searchInput  = document.getElementById('search-input');
const sortSelect   = document.getElementById('sort-select');
const message      = document.getElementById('message');
const messageTxt   = document.getElementById('message-text');

const player    = document.getElementById('player');
const plVideo   = document.getElementById('pl-video');
const plName    = document.getElementById('pl-name');
const plCounter = document.getElementById('pl-counter');
const plPrev    = document.getElementById('pl-prev');
const plNext    = document.getElementById('pl-next');

const fmtSize = b => b < 1024 ? b+'B' : b < 1048576 ? (b/1024).toFixed(1)+'KB' : (b/1048576).toFixed(1)+'MB';
const fmtTime = iso => { const d=new Date(iso); return d.toLocaleDateString('pl-PL')+' '+d.toLocaleTimeString('pl-PL',{hour:'2-digit',minute:'2-digit'}); };

async function fetchOrder() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(ORDER_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(data.order) ? data.order : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

async function fetchListing() {
  const res = await fetch(BUCKET_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+res.status);
  const xml = await res.text();
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml');
  const items = [];
  doc.querySelectorAll('Contents').forEach(n => {
    const key = n.querySelector('Key')?.textContent || '';
    if (!(key.startsWith(ORIG_PREFIX) && VIDEO_EXT.test(key))) return;
    const size    = parseInt(n.querySelector('Size')?.textContent||'0');
    const lastMod = n.querySelector('LastModified')?.textContent||'';
    items.push({
      key, size, lastMod,
      url: BUCKET_URL + key.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'),
    });
  });
  return items;
}

function applyFiltersAndSort(vids) {
  const q  = searchInput.value.trim().toLowerCase();
  const by = sortSelect.value;
  let arr  = q ? vids.filter(v => v.key.toLowerCase().includes(q)) : [...vids];
  if (by==='newest') arr.sort((a,b)=>new Date(b.lastMod)-new Date(a.lastMod));
  else if (by==='oldest') arr.sort((a,b)=>new Date(a.lastMod)-new Date(b.lastMod));
  else if (by==='name')   arr.sort((a,b)=>a.key.localeCompare(b.key));
  else if (by==='size')   arr.sort((a,b)=>b.size-a.size);
  else if (by==='custom' && customOrder) {
    const rank = new Map(customOrder.map((name,i)=>[name,i]));
    arr.sort((a,b) => {
      const an = a.key.split('/').pop(), bn = b.key.split('/').pop();
      const ra = rank.has(an) ? rank.get(an) : Infinity;
      const rb = rank.has(bn) ? rank.get(bn) : Infinity;
      if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb;
      return new Date(b.lastMod) - new Date(a.lastMod);
    });
  }
  return arr;
}

function thumbCacheKey(vid) { return THUMB_CACHE_PREFIX + vid.key + '_' + vid.size; }

function generateThumb(vid, imgEl, fallbackEl) {
  const cacheKey = thumbCacheKey(vid);
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if (cached) { imgEl.src = cached; imgEl.style.display = ''; fallbackEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }
  } catch {}

  const v = document.createElement('video');
  v.crossOrigin = 'anonymous';
  v.muted = true;
  v.playsInline = true;
  v.preload = 'metadata';
  v.src = vid.url;

  const cleanup = () => { v.src = ''; v.remove(); };

  v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => {
    v.currentTime = Math.min(1, (v.duration || 2) / 2);
  });
  v.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      const scale = THUMB_W / v.videoWidth;
      canvas.width = THUMB_W;
      canvas.height = Math.round(v.videoHeight * scale);
      const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
      ctx.drawImage(v, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
      imgEl.src = dataUrl;
      imgEl.style.display = '';
      fallbackEl.style.display = 'none';
      try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, dataUrl); } catch {}
    } catch (e) { /* CORS-tainted canvas or decode error — keep fallback */ }
    cleanup();
  });
  v.addEventListener('error', cleanup);
  document.body.appendChild(v);
  v.style.display = 'none';
}

function renderGallery() {
  visibleVideos = applyFiltersAndSort(allVideos);
  gallery.innerHTML = '';

  if (!visibleVideos.length) {
    messageTxt.textContent = searchInput.value ? 'Brak wyników.' : 'Brak filmów w buckecie.';
    message.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }
  message.classList.remove('visible');

  visibleVideos.forEach((vid, idx) => {
    const item = document.createElement('div');
    item.className = 'vid-item';
    item.innerHTML = `
      <img style="display:none" alt="${vid.key}" />
      <div class="thumb-fallback">▶ film</div>
      <div class="play-badge">▶</div>
      <div class="vid-overlay">${vid.key.split('/').pop()}<br>${fmtSize(vid.size)} · ${fmtTime(vid.lastMod)}</div>`;
    const imgEl = item.querySelector('img');
    const fallbackEl = item.querySelector('.thumb-fallback');
    generateThumb(vid, imgEl, fallbackEl);
    item.addEventListener('click', () => openPlayer(idx));
    gallery.appendChild(item);
  });
}

function openPlayer(idx) {
  plIndex = idx;
  player.classList.add('open');
  loadPlayerVideo();
}
function closePlayer() {
  player.classList.remove('open');
  plVideo.pause();
  plVideo.src = '';
}
function loadPlayerVideo() {
  const vid = visibleVideos[plIndex];
  if (!vid) return;
  plName.textContent = vid.key.split('/').pop();
  plCounter.textContent = `${plIndex+1} / ${visibleVideos.length}`;
  plPrev.classList.toggle('hidden', plIndex===0);
  plNext.classList.toggle('hidden', plIndex===visibleVideos.length-1);
  plVideo.src = vid.url;
  plVideo.play().catch(()=>{});
}
function navigate(dir) {
  const next = plIndex + dir;
  if (next < 0 || next >= visibleVideos.length) return;
  plIndex = next;
  loadPlayerVideo();
}

document.getElementById('pl-close').addEventListener('click', closePlayer);
plPrev.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(-1));
plNext.addEventListener('click', () => navigate(1));
player.addEventListener('click', e => { if (e.target === player) closePlayer(); });
document.addEventListener('keydown', e => {
  if (!player.classList.contains('open')) return;
  if (e.key==='Escape') closePlayer();
  else if (e.key==='ArrowLeft') navigate(-1);
  else if (e.key==='ArrowRight') navigate(1);
});

document.getElementById('refresh-btn').addEventListener('click', load);
searchInput.addEventListener('input', renderGallery);
sortSelect.addEventListener('change', renderGallery);

async function load() {
  try {
    allVideos = await fetchListing();
    customOrder = await fetchOrder();
    if (customOrder) sortSelect.value = 'custom';
    renderGallery();
  } catch (err) {
    messageTxt.textContent = 'Nie można pobrać listy filmów.';
    message.classList.add('visible');
    console.error('[emores-videos]', err);
  }
}

load();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<body>

<header>
  <div class="logo">emoresz<span>.</span> <span style="color:var(--text-muted);font-size:12px;">— kolejność</span></div>
  <nav class="top-nav"><a href="index.html">Zdjęcia</a> &nbsp; <a href="videos.html">Filmy</a></nav>
</header>

<div id="gate">
  <p style="color:var(--text-muted)">Wklej token administratora, aby edytować kolejność.</p>
  <input type="password" id="token-input" placeholder="token" autocomplete="off" />
  <button class="btn primary" id="token-save">Zapisz token</button>
</div>

<div id="app" style="display:none">
  <div class="toolbar">
    <button class="btn" id="sort-newest">Najnowsze</button>
    <button class="btn" id="sort-oldest">Najstarsze</button>
    <button class="btn" id="sort-name">Nazwa A–Z</button>
    <button class="btn" id="sort-size">Rozmiar</button>
    <div class="toolbar-sep"></div>
    <button class="btn primary" id="save-btn">💾 Zapisz kolejność</button>
    <span id="save-status"></span>
  </div>
  <div id="gallery"></div>
  <div id="message"><span id="message-text">Ładowanie…</span></div>
</div>

<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/sortablejs@1.15.2/Sortable.min.js"></script>
<script>
const BUCKET_URL   = 'https://storage.googleapis.com/emores/';
const ORIG_PREFIX  = 'emores2/';
const THUMB_PREFIX = 'thumbs/';
const ORDER_URL    = BUCKET_URL + 'order.json?ts=' + Date.now();
const SAVE_ENDPOINT = 'https://save-order-662677831309.europe-central2.run.app';
const IMAGE_EXT = /\.(jpe?g|png|gif|webp|svg|bmp|tiff?)$/i;
const VIDEO_EXT = /\.(mp4|mov|webm|mkv|avi|m4v)$/i;
const THUMB_CACHE_PREFIX = 'emores_vthumb_';
const THUMB_W = 200;
const TOKEN_KEY = 'emores_admin_token';

const gate       = document.getElementById('gate');
const app        = document.getElementById('app');
const tokenInput = document.getElementById('token-input');
const gallery    = document.getElementById('gallery');
const message    = document.getElementById('message');
const messageTxt = document.getElementById('message-text');
const saveStatus = document.getElementById('save-status');

let items = [];   // {key, size, lastMod, url, thumbUrl, isVideo, basename}

function getToken() {
  const url = new URL(location.href);
  const fromUrl = url.searchParams.get('token');
  if (fromUrl) { localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, fromUrl); return fromUrl; }
  return localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY);
}

document.getElementById('token-save').addEventListener('click', () => {
  const t = tokenInput.value.trim();
  if (!t) return;
  localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, t);
  init();
});

async function fetchListing() {
  const res = await fetch(BUCKET_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP '+res.status);
  const xml = await res.text();
  const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml, 'application/xml');
  const thumbKeys = new Set();
  doc.querySelectorAll('Contents').forEach(n => {
    const key = n.querySelector('Key')?.textContent || '';
    if (key.startsWith(THUMB_PREFIX)) thumbKeys.add(key);
  });
  const out = [];
  doc.querySelectorAll('Contents').forEach(n => {
    const key = n.querySelector('Key')?.textContent || '';
    if (!key.startsWith(ORIG_PREFIX)) return;
    const isImage = IMAGE_EXT.test(key);
    const isVideo = VIDEO_EXT.test(key);
    if (!isImage && !isVideo) return;

    const size    = parseInt(n.querySelector('Size')?.textContent||'0');
    const lastMod = n.querySelector('LastModified')?.textContent||'';
    const basename = key.split('/').pop();
    const nameParts = basename.split('.');
    const ext = nameParts.pop().toLowerCase();
    const nameNoExt = nameParts.join('.');
    const thumbKey = THUMB_PREFIX + nameNoExt + '_64x64_thumbnail.' + ext;

    out.push({
      key, size, lastMod, basename, isVideo,
      url: BUCKET_URL + key.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/'),
      thumbUrl: isImage && thumbKeys.has(thumbKey) ? BUCKET_URL + thumbKey.split('/').map(encodeURIComponent).join('/') : null,
    });
  });
  return out;
}

async function fetchOrder() {
  try {
    const res = await fetch(ORDER_URL, { cache: 'no-store' });
    if (!res.ok) return null;
    const data = await res.json();
    return Array.isArray(data.order) ? data.order : null;
  } catch { return null; }
}

function applyOrder(list, order) {
  if (!order) return list;
  const rank = new Map(order.map((name,i)=>[name,i]));
  return [...list].sort((a,b) => {
    const ra = rank.has(a.basename) ? rank.get(a.basename) : Infinity;
    const rb = rank.has(b.basename) ? rank.get(b.basename) : Infinity;
    if (ra !== rb) return ra - rb;
    return new Date(b.lastMod) - new Date(a.lastMod);
  });
}

function thumbCacheKey(it) { return THUMB_CACHE_PREFIX + it.key + '_' + it.size; }

function generateVideoThumb(it, imgEl, fallbackEl) {
  const cacheKey = thumbCacheKey(it);
  try {
    const cached = localStorage.getItem(cacheKey);
    if (cached) { imgEl.src = cached; imgEl.style.display=''; fallbackEl.style.display='none'; return; }
  } catch {}
  const v = document.createElement('video');
  v.crossOrigin = 'anonymous'; v.muted = true; v.playsInline = true; v.preload = 'metadata';
  v.src = it.url;
  const cleanup = () => { v.src=''; v.remove(); };
  v.addEventListener('loadedmetadata', () => { v.currentTime = Math.min(1, (v.duration||2)/2); });
  v.addEventListener('seeked', () => {
    try {
      const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
      const scale = THUMB_W / v.videoWidth;
      canvas.width = THUMB_W; canvas.height = Math.round(v.videoHeight*scale);
      canvas.getContext('2d').drawImage(v, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
      const dataUrl = canvas.toDataURL('image/jpeg', 0.7);
      imgEl.src = dataUrl; imgEl.style.display=''; fallbackEl.style.display='none';
      try { localStorage.setItem(cacheKey, dataUrl); } catch {}
    } catch {}
    cleanup();
  });
  v.addEventListener('error', cleanup);
  document.body.appendChild(v);
  v.style.display = 'none';
}

function render() {
  gallery.innerHTML = '';
  if (!items.length) {
    messageTxt.textContent = 'Brak plików w buckecie.';
    message.classList.add('visible');
    return;
  }
  message.classList.remove('visible');

  items.forEach(it => {
    const el = document.createElement('div');
    el.className = 'g-item';
    el.dataset.basename = it.basename;
    el.innerHTML = `
      <img style="display:none" alt="${it.basename}" />
      <div class="thumb-fallback">${it.isVideo ? '▶' : '…'}</div>
      ${it.isVideo ? '<span class="g-video-tag">wideo</span>' : ''}
      <div class="g-name">${it.basename}</div>`;
    const imgEl = el.querySelector('img');
    const fallbackEl = el.querySelector('.thumb-fallback');
    if (it.isVideo) {
      generateVideoThumb(it, imgEl, fallbackEl);
    } else if (it.thumbUrl) {
      imgEl.src = it.thumbUrl;
      imgEl.style.display = '';
      fallbackEl.style.display = 'none';
      imgEl.addEventListener('error', () => { imgEl.src = it.url; });
    } else {
      imgEl.src = it.url;
      imgEl.style.display = '';
      fallbackEl.style.display = 'none';
    }
    gallery.appendChild(el);
  });
}

function currentOrderFromDom() {
  return [...gallery.children].map(el => el.dataset.basename);
}

function sortBy(fn) {
  items.sort(fn);
  render();
}
document.getElementById('sort-newest').addEventListener('click', () => sortBy((a,b)=>new Date(b.lastMod)-new Date(a.lastMod)));
document.getElementById('sort-oldest').addEventListener('click', () => sortBy((a,b)=>new Date(a.lastMod)-new Date(b.lastMod)));
document.getElementById('sort-name').addEventListener('click',   () => sortBy((a,b)=>a.basename.localeCompare(b.basename)));
document.getElementById('sort-size').addEventListener('click',   () => sortBy((a,b)=>b.size-a.size));

document.getElementById('save-btn').addEventListener('click', async () => {
  const token = getToken();
  if (!token) { showGate(); return; }
  saveStatus.textContent = 'zapisywanie…';
  saveStatus.className = '';
  try {
    const res = await fetch(SAVE_ENDPOINT, {
      method: 'POST',
      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token },
      body: JSON.stringify({ order: currentOrderFromDom(), mode: 'manual' }),
    });
    if (!res.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + res.status);
    saveStatus.textContent = 'zapisano ✓';
    saveStatus.className = 'ok';
  } catch (err) {
    saveStatus.textContent = 'błąd zapisu';
    saveStatus.className = 'err';
    console.error('[emores-admin]', err);
  }
});

function showGate() {
  gate.style.display = 'flex';
  app.style.display = 'none';
}

async function init() {
  const token = getToken();
  if (!token) { showGate(); return; }
  gate.style.display = 'none';
  app.style.display = 'block';

  try {
    const [listing, order] = await Promise.all([fetchListing(), fetchOrder()]);
    items = applyOrder(listing, order);
    render();
    new Sortable(gallery, { animation: 150, ghostClass: 'sortable-ghost', chosenClass: 'sortable-chosen' });
  } catch (err) {
    messageTxt.textContent = 'Nie można pobrać listy plików.';
    message.classList.add('visible');
    console.error('[emores-admin]', err);
  }
}

init();
</script>
</body>
</html>
